_note: Oblimap import template (same format as an export). Fill in the sections you need and delete the rest. UUIDs are optional: omit them to always create new records; when a UUID matches an existing record, the conflict strategy chosen at import time decides whether to update it, ignore it or create a copy. References between sections (parentUuid, groupUuid, scopeUuid) use these UUIDs. Every value below is a fake example.

siteGroups._note: A top-level group. parentUuid null = root group.
siteGroups.name: Example Company

siteGroups._note: A sub-group: parentUuid points at the group above.
siteGroups.name: Example Branch Offices

sites._note: A site in the top-level group.
sites.name: Example Head Office

settings._note: Group setting, inherited by the group's sub-groups and sites.
Site settings: JSON lists of IPv4 CIDRs / ports.

notificationChannels._note: Generic webhook. Secrets may be left out (or set to "__REDACTED__"); a channel whose secret cannot be restored is imported disabled. Bindings attach the channel globally or to a group / site.
notificationChannels.name: Example Webhook

teams._note: Teams and their permissions (ro = read, rw = read / write) on groups or sites. Memberships are never imported.
teams.name: Example Network Team

siteSubnets._note: Named subnets of a site (siteUuid). Prefix /16 to /30; the gateway, when set, must be inside the subnet. Keyed by site + CIDR.
siteSubnets.name: Example office LAN

reservations._note: IP reservations, keyed by site + IP. reservedMac (optional) is the device the IP is reserved for: that device holding the IP is no conflict.
reservations.name: Example printer

siteItems._note: A manual device (isManual true): created when no device of the site has this MAC (or this IP when there is no MAC).
A discovered device (isManual false): never created by an import, only its name, notes, alert mode and (when not null) device type are applied to the device the probes found with this MAC.

vendorRules._note: Vendor → device type rules (substring of the vendor name, case-insensitive). groupUuid null = the whole workspace. Importing them also needs the device checks capability.

macVendorOverrides._note: Platform administrators only: custom names of OUI prefixes of the IEEE table (shared by every workspace). Unknown prefixes are skipped.

permissionSets._note: Platform administrators only: custom permission sets (shared by every workspace), keyed by slug. The default sets are never changed by an import.
permissionSets.name: Example helpdesk
